title: VirION: Long-read, low-input, viral metagenomic sequencing with MinION
author: Joanna JWD Warwick-Dugdale
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p8fdrtn
materials: Using thermocycler program 1, incubate for: 5 mins at 20 °C 5 min at 65 °C, 1 min 20 °C Then transfer to fresh DNA LoBind tube

To 30 μl of end-prepped amplified DNA, add: 20 μl AMX 50 μl NEB Blunt / TA Master Mix (resulting in a final volume of 100 μl) Mix by gentle flicking, then spin down Mix between each addition by gentle flicking; spin down

steps.title: Shear DNA
steps.instruction: Shear DNA using a Covaris g-TUBE to obtain approximately 8 Kbp fragments.

substeps.instruction: Gently flick to ensure DNA is not stuck to the tube, spin down, and transfer <1 μg DNA in 47 μl NFW/EB into the top compartment of a Covaris g-TUBE and screw on lid.
Spin g-TUBE for 1 min at 6000 rpm; verify DNA has transferred to the lower compartment (repeat if necessary).
Flip tube (base upwards) and spin again for 1 min at 6000 rpm; verify DNA has transferred into the lid (repeat if necessary).
Keep total processing time <15 min. Note: spin speed may need optimization if using a different microcentrifuge model.
Keep g-TUBE base upward, unscrew, and transfer DNA from lid to a fresh LoBind Eppendorf or 0.2 ml PCR tube.
Retain 1 μl of sheared DNA for QuBit fluorimeter quantification.

steps.title: End-Prep DNA
steps.instruction: Perform end-repair and phosphorylation of fragmented DNA.

substeps.instruction: To 45 μl of fragmented and repaired DNA, add 5 μl NFW, 7 μl Ultra II End-Prep buffer, and 3 μl Ultra II End-Prep enzyme mix (60 μl total volume).
Mix by gentle flicking and spin down; transfer to a 0.2 ml PCR tube if needed.
Vortex AMPure beads to resuspend, add 60 μl of beads to the reaction, and mix by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 5 mins at RT on a rotator or by flicking every ~1 min.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless (~2 min).
Discard supernatant while keeping the tube on the magnet.
Wash beads with 200 µl freshly prepared 80% ethanol (leave ~15 secs without disturbing pellet).
Remove and discard 80% ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Spin down briefly, replace on magnet, pipette off residual wash, and allow to dry for ~1-2 min (avoid over-drying).
Remove from magnet and resuspend pellet in 31 µl nuclease-free water by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 2 minutes at 55 °C in a heat block.
Pellet beads on magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless (~2 min).
Transfer eluate to a fresh DNA LoBind tube and retain 1 µl for QuBit quantification (Recovery aim: ≥ 20 ng).

steps.title: Ligate PCR Adapters
steps.instruction: Ligate PCR adapters to the end-prepped DNA.

substeps.instruction: To 30 μl of end-prepped DNA, add 20 μl of PCA and 50 μl Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix (100 μl total volume).
Mix by gentle flicking and spin down between each addition.
Incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Vortex AMPure beads to resuspend, add 40 μl of beads to the reaction (0.4x wash), and mix by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 5 mins at RT on a rotator or by flicking every ~1 min.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless (~3 min).
Discard supernatant while keeping the tube on the magnet.
Wash beads with 200 µl freshly prepared 80% ethanol (leave ~15 secs).
Remove and discard 80% ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Briefly spin down, replace on magnet, pipette off residual wash, and allow to dry.
Remove from magnet and resuspend pellet in 26 µl nuclease-free water by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 2 minutes at 55 °C in a heat block.
Pellet beads on magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless (~3 min).
Transfer eluate to a fresh DNA LoBind tube.
Quantify 1 µl of ligated DNA via High Sensitivity (HS) QuBit fluorimeter (also quantify retained DNA from previous stages).

steps.title: Amplify DNA via PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the adapter-ligated DNA using a high-fidelity master mix.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volume of PCR-adapter ligated DNA needed to provide ~20 ng (e.g., 8 µl if concentration is 2.7 ng/µl).
Set up PCR reactions (100 µl total) in 0.2 ml thin-walled tubes on ice: 40 µl NFW, 2 µl PRM (primers), ~20 ng PCR adapted DNA, and 50 µl NEB Next High Fidelity 2X master mix.
Mix by gentle flicking and spin down briefly. Set up multiple reactions and a lambda positive control.
Run the following thermal cycler program: Initial denaturation 3 mins at 95°C; 15 cycles of (15s at 95°C, 15s at 62°C, 5 min at 72°C); Final Extension 5 min at 72°C; Hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Clean Up PCR Products
steps.instruction: Perform a 0.4x bead wash to remove small amplification products.

substeps.instruction: Spin down and transfer each PCR reaction to a fresh DNA LoBind tube.
Vortex AMPure beads to resuspend, add 40 μl of beads to each reaction, and mix by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 5 mins at RT on a rotator or by flicking every ~1 min.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet until eluates are clear and colorless (~3 min).
Discard supernatant while keeping tubes on the magnet.
Wash beads with 200 µl freshly prepared 80% ethanol (leave ~15 secs).
Remove and discard 80% ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Briefly spin down, replace on magnet, pipette off residual wash, and allow to dry.
Remove from magnet and resuspend pellets in 26 µl nuclease-free water by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 2 minutes at 55°C in a heat block.
Pellet beads on magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless (~3 min).
Transfer eluate to fresh DNA LoBind tube.
Perform QC: Quantify 1 µl via Broad Range (BR) QuBit and analyze 1 µl via Bioanalyzer/Tapestation. Ensure no high molecular weight product is present; if observed, repeat PCR with fewer cycles.

steps.title: Final Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform final end-prep and adapter ligation to create the sequencing library.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate 3-3.5 µg of PCR product into 45 µl of NFW (e.g., via SpeedVac).
To 45 µl of PCR product, add 5 μl NFW, 7 μl Ultra II End-Prep buffer, and 3 μl Ultra II End-Prep enzyme mix (60 μl total).
Mix by gentle flicking, spin down, and transfer to a 0.2 ml PCR tube.
Vortex AMPure beads to resuspend, add 60 μl of beads, and mix by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 5 mins at RT on a rotator or by flicking every ~1 min.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet until eluate is clear and colorless (~2 min).
Discard supernatant while keeping the tube on the magnet.
Wash beads with 200 µl freshly prepared 80% ethanol (leave ~15 secs).
Remove and discard 80% ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Spin down, replace on magnet, pipette off residual wash, and allow to dry.
Remove from magnet and resuspend pellet in 31 µl nuclease-free water by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 2 minutes at 55 °C in a heat block.
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear and colorless (~2 min).
Transfer eluate to fresh DNA LoBind tube and retain 1 µl for QuBit quantification (Recovery aim: >2500 ng).
Incubate the ligation reaction at RT for 10 minutes.
Vortex AMPure beads to resuspend, add 40 μl of beads to the adapter ligation reaction, and mix by gentle flicking.
Incubate for 5 mins at RT on a rotator or by flicking every ~1 min.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet until eluate is clear and colorless (~3 min).
Discard supernatant while keeping the tube on the magnet.
Add 140 μl of ABB to the beads, remove from magnet, and resuspend by gentle flicking.
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear and colorless (~5 min).
Carefully remove and discard supernatant using a pipette.
Repeat the ABB wash (addition and removal of 140 μl) once more.
Resuspend pelleted beads in 15 μl ELB by gentle but tenacious flicking; incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear and colorless (~5 min).
Remove and retain 15 µl of eluate into a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube and place on ice.
Perform a second elution: add 15 μl ELB to the pellet, resuspend, incubate at RT for 10 min, pellet on magnet, and retain the second eluate in a clean 1.5 ml tube on ice.
Quantify 1 µl of both elutions via QuBit fluorimeter (Recovery aim for RT eluate: >1000 ng / ~75ng/µl).

steps.title: MinION Setup and QC
steps.instruction: Prepare the host computer and MinION device for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Ensure host computer has internet, >150 GB free space on C drive, and all sleep/screensaver modes disabled.
Connect MinION to computer, open MinKNOW software, check for updates, and ensure MinION configuration has been run.
Insert flow cell (flow chip adjacent to hinge), close cover, and verify 'Flowcell connection' and ID in MinKNOW.
Label 'Experiment' and 'Sample ID', and select 'Platform QC' operation.
Start QC; place MinION on insulating/conductive surface and modify airflow to reach ~34 °C. Run for ~10 min and note available pore channels (should be ≥1000).
Prepare priming buffer: Vortex/pipette RBF, spin down, and add 576 μl RBF to 624 μl NFW (1200 μl total); vortex and spin down.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming and Loading
steps.instruction: Prime the flow cell and load the prepared DNA library.

substeps.instruction: Open MinION lid and flow cell Priming Port (turn clockwise).
Using a Gilson 1000 μl pipette at the Priming Port, slowly draw back a few µls of yellow QC buffer to ensure liquid-liquid contact and remove bubbles.
Allow flow cell to prime for 5 min.

Prepare library loading mix in a fresh low bind tube: 35 μl RBF, 2.5 μl NFW, 25.5 μl LLB, and 12 μl of adapted and tethered DNA library (75 μl total). Mix by gentle flicking; resuspend LLB by pipetting before transfer.
Open Spot-ON sample port cover. Carefully add 200 μl of priming buffer to the Priming Port (not Spot-ON port), maintaining liquid-liquid contact (remove a few µls of buffer first if needed).
Resuspend beads in the library loading mix via pipette and immediately load into the Spot-ON Sample Port dropwise.
Replace Spot-ON Sample Port cover (ensure bung enters port), close Priming Port cover, and replace MinION lid.
Wait 1 hour prior to starting the sequencing run.

steps.title: Sequencing Run
steps.instruction: Configure and execute the sequencing run in MinKNOW.

substeps.instruction: Select library prep kit SQK-LSK108 and flow cell FLO-MIN106 (R9.4).
Switch base calling to 'Off' and set for a 48-hour run.
Click 'Begin Experiment'.
Note the number of pores in pre-sequencing QC ('Mux') and check pore occupancy (high 'in-stand pore' to 'single pore' ratio).
Monitor the Message panel until the run is complete or manually stop the protocol.
Base call reads from the stored files (typically in C:\MinION_data\reads).

description: Avoiding the introduction of air bubbles, load 800 µl of the priming mix via the Priming Port: wind a vertical Gilson pipette (clockwise), use pipette plunger (with care) under 200-100 µl volume, and remove pipette with a few µls left in tip
